title: CAST: Corpus-Aware Self-similarity Enhanced Topic modelling
task: Selecting better topic words in embedding-clustering topic models
problem: Top2Vec-style models embed candidate topic words without context (a contextualisation gap) and often select functional words.
architecture: Document embeddings, UMAP and HDBSCAN as in Top2Vec; each candidate word embedding is the average of its contextualised embeddings across the corpus; words with low self-similarity across contexts (functional words) are filtered with a threshold (0.4); topic words are those nearest each cluster centroid.
key_results: 20NewsGroups: CAST-MPNET TC 0.18 and LLM-TC 3.88 vs BERTopic-MPNET 0.11 and 3.2, Top2Vec-MiniLM 0.1 and 3.59.
TopClus has the highest TD on all datasets (1 on 20NewsGroups and BBC News).
Functional words such as 'inform' (self-similarity 0.218) and 'implement' (0.26) are removed at threshold 0.4.
strengths: Two simple add-on modules usable with other embedding-based topic models.
Handles noisy, non-preprocessed text and shows NPMI can reward stop-word topics.

limitations.text: Relies on pretrained embeddings that may carry biases; higher computation for contextualised word embeddings on large datasets.
On Elon Musk tweets CAST has lower TD than BERTopic (0.62-0.73 vs 0.93-0.96).
